note: 'That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.' (Matt 18:35) -- the teller supplying his own application, in the same breath.
Told in Matthew 18, the chapter that runs from the disciples asking who is greatest to Peter asking how often to forgive.

'Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?' (Matt 18:21), answered 'Until seventy times seven' (18:22).

'That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him.' (Matt 22:23), answered with 'You are mistaken because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God' (22:29).
